name: WARNING: Raw Whole Baby Carrots (Insoluble Crunch & Stricture Risk)
whyItWorks: Dense, hard raw carrots served on party platters and lunchboxes. Even with extensive chewing, sharp jagged carrot fragments scrape inflamed ulcers and easily collect at ileocecal valve strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never eat hard raw carrots during active inflammation or with strictures. Always steam, boil, or roast peeled carrots until fork-tender.
